subQuests.subQuestName: Wait till the next morning (08:00 – 12:00) and talk to Fushizome

726900101.text: The day has finally arrived, you two.

726900102.text: You have already grasped the essence of the composition of floral courtyards.

726900103.text: Now, it's time for a real test of your floral art mastery.

726900104.text: Eh? We've already grasped the essence of it?

726900105.text: And "real test," you say... So this is gonna be the hardest theme, right? Ohh, Paimon's getting kinda worried.

726900106.text: We haven't spent that long doing ikebana, to be honest.

726900107.text: Yes, it is true that the act of processing the flowers must be practiced over a great length of time. However, the planning and structuring of floral courtyards is more dependent on awareness and inspiration.

726900108.text: If we're merely talking about the latter, the two of you have displayed stunning talent. I do not believe that you need any further refinement via thematic quizzes.

726900109.text: Or perhaps I should say that it must be your fascinating travels and the sights you've seen, the likes of which I could never imagine, that has conferred this unique mindscape upon you.

726900111.text: #Speaking of which, {NICKNAME}, we really have been to lots of places and seen loads of things. To think that would've given us so much inspiration...

726900112.text: Paimon wonders how much of it we've spent on learning this art?

726900116.text: Thanks so much, Ms. Fushizome! If it wasn't for your guidance, we wouldn't have discovered this hidden talent of ours at all!

726900117.text: Haha. You're too kind. Well then, let us close this journey off with the loveliest floral courtyard of them all.

726870201.text: In the following days, I will continue to stay here and guide those who come for the Irodori Festival, and help them to enjoy the beauty of the "floral courtyards."

726870202.text: Don't forget to drop by every day to get another "theme." There will be a total of four such themes for you to figure out.

726870203.text: Of course, if you have any other questions, I will do my best to answer them for you.

726870205.text: The flowers I use are all provided by Sakuya's Flowers. The flowers they grow are of impeccable quality and affordable prices.

726870206.text: Perhaps you've met Sakuya as well. We once studied ikebana under the same master.

726870207.text: Sakuya is also very well-studied in the floral arts, but when she heard that there would be tons of people at the Irodori Festival, she seemed to have gotten a bit of stage fright. She said that it would be difficult to quiet down and focus on her work in such an environment.

726870208.text: In any case, I will advertise Sakuya's Flowers on her behalf.

726870209.text: We can help too if you need us!

726870219.text: Well then, do the two of you have any other questions?

726870221.text: Think nothing of it. If you have time, you can come and look for me any time.

726870211.text: The Yashiro Commission has always been very supportive of Inazuma's floral arts. Indeed, the person who sponsored this event is the Shirasagi Himegimi.

726870212.text: She has always been incredibly talented in these arts, even from a young age. I saw her perform ikebana once, and even had the honor of exchanging pointers with her.

726870213.text: Although I'm older than her, I'm nowhere near her ability in terms of skill in ikebana or understanding of the floral arts.

726870214.text: Where circumstances have permitted, she has provided funding to help publicize ikebana every year. I've even heard that she has used her own savings to do so...

726870215.text: She once expressed her frank desire for more people to understand ikebana and to drum up more interest in it such that more might want to practice this art.

726870216.text: Huh. So Ayaka did so much for Inazuma's floral arts...

726870217.text: I hope her wish comes true.

726870218.text: Thank you both. You are indeed good-hearted people.

726870223.text: Alright, then. You can come and look for me any time.
